InMotion Hosting is ideal for small to medium size business websites with light to moderate traffic. WordPress bloggers will also be highly impressed with InMotion Hosting’s speed and performance. InMotion Hosting is our top ranking Shared Hosting option. InMotion’s speed test results were equal to (and sometimes actually better than) some of the top managed WordPress hosts that we’ve tested. Who shouldn’t buy InMotion Hosting? Although InMotion Hosting posted good load testing numbers, performance did decline with heavier traffic loads. Also, WooCommerce performance could have been better—especially with advanced traffic stores. For these reasons, if you expect heavy traffic or frequent traffic spikes, we would recommend managed WordPress hosting or Cloud VPS. > Download Full Test Report > Try InMotion Hosting
